subject: Post-call: Octane AI trial routing, ops owners & next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aimee Clarke <aimee.clarke@octaneai.com>
Cc: Peter Nguyen <peter@octaneai.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — Octane AI discovery + proposed trial routing

Team / Aimee — thanks for the call today. Quick recap and proposed way forward so we can get the trial moving next week.

Call summary (high level):
- Use case: in-product recommendations + customer support snippets (short-form text gen + embeddings for search).
- Target SLO: 95th percentile latency < 120ms for 1–2k qps test windows; cost target: < $0.0006/token average with batching + quantized LLM.
- Security: Octane is in scope for SOC2; they will need audit log access and isolated network for the pilot (VPC peering or private link).

Proposed POC scope and success criteria (draft):
1) Basic functional: integration with SDK, end-to-end inference for recommendations in staging (test harness) — owners: App (Octane) / SRE (Redwood).
2) Latency & throughput: achieve sustained 1k qps for 5 minutes with 95th pct latency < 120ms — owners: Redwood infra (Rishi) / Octane infra (Peter).
3) Security & compliance: evidence of access controls + audit logs for sample window — owners: Security (Marissa) / Octane security (Sofia).
4) Cost & config: run 1000 synthetic requests to measure per-token cost with suggested batching and quantization — owners: Solutions (Rishi) / Sales (Hannah).

Immediate asks / next steps (timeline):
- Today: finalize owners and procurement contact (Aimee — please confirm procurement owner).
- By Fri 7/2: delivery of trial config (redwood-trial-config.yaml) and MAP draft from us. (I attached an initial MAP and config.)
- Week of 7/5: infra handshake — network & VPC peering test window (1–2 days).
- Week of 7/12: run controlled performance window + cost run.

RACI (working draft) — please comment inline:
- Responsible (R): Redwood solutions (Rishi) for environment setup and perf runs; Octane app owner for SDK integration.
- Accountable (A): Hannah (Sales) for overall timeline; Octane product sponsor (Aimee) for acceptance.
- Consulted (C): Karthik on procurement and legal triggers; Marissa on SOC2 evidence mapping.
- Informed (I): Exec stakeholders if cost/latency targets not met.

Attachments: 20270630-MAP-draft.xlsx, redwood-trial-config.yaml, SOC2-evidence-req.pdf

Aimee / Peter: anything missing or off with timeline? If this looks good I’ll lock owners and kick off the MAP doc for signature.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — Octane AI discovery + proposed trial routing

Thanks Hannah — concise. Two procurement/legal items I want captured before we start:

1) Data residency & retention: Octane needs confirmation that trial logs will be retained for 90 days and that any persisted embeddings are stored in their VPC. Can Marissa confirm feasibility and whether additional paperwork is needed?

2) Billing / trial credit: we typically ask for an internal trial PO for Reserved we might exceed during the perf window; Aimee, does Octane prefer a spend cap + credit or short-term PO for the dedicated window?

Also, to avoid rework, please confirm who will be the primary technical contact on the Octane side for network tests (Peter?) — I will loop legal if retention requires amendments.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Product Manager, Trials | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aimee Clarke <aimee.clarke@octaneai.com>, Peter Nguyen <peter@octaneai.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — Octane AI discovery + proposed trial routing

Adding technical clarity / proposed owner assignments from infra side.

Network & infra tasks (Rishi = Redwood infra lead):
- R: create trial compute pool & pre-warm kernels (quantized weights) for candidate models.
- R: provide a small test harness and step-by-step runbook for Octane to exercise the API during the perf window. (I attached a sample runbook snippet to the config.)
- A: Redwood infra to own latency test execution and log collection.
- C: Octane infra (Peter) to validate peering and provide endpoints for staging.

App integration tasks (Octane):
- R: Octane app owner to implement SDK call sites (recommendations endpoint) and run smoke tests.
- C: Redwood solutions (me) to assist with batching settings and KV cache hints.

Security & compliance:
- R: Marissa to confirm if SOC2 evidence can be packaged in the requested 7/2 window. If not, propose an alternate deliverable list we can accept for the pilot (e.g., signed attestation + sample audit logs).

RACI snapshot (compact):
- Infra setup: R=Rishi, A=Hannah, C=Peter, I=Karthik
- App integration: R=Peter/Aimee (Octane), A=Aimee, C=Rishi, I=Marissa
- Compliance evidence: R=Marissa, A=Marissa, C=Aimee, I=Hannah

Timeline check: I can provision a small quantized test pool by 7/5 if we get network endpoints and a test token by 7/2. If Octane needs VPC peering we’ll need the peering request by 7/2 to hit the 7/5 window.

Thanks all — that aligns with our internal read. Quick notes from Octane: 

- Procurement: we’ll start with a spend cap + credit for the perf window. Sofia Ruiz (cc’d) is our procurement lead and will send the PO template / preferred terms by EOD Friday (7/2).
- Network: Peter is primary for peering and staging endpoints — he will schedule a 30m tech hop 7/6 or 7/7.
- Compliance: we can provide a SOC2 attestation and limited audit logs for the pilot; full evidence pack will take longer but attestation + logs work for go/no-go.

We’re comfortable with the RACI as written. Please flag anything blocking on your side — otherwise we’ll expect the MAP and trial config by Friday so Peter can do the staging test early week.

Thanks,
Aimee
